notes_for_editor: Build (1933), abandonment (1940s) and the 2013-2014 restoration agree across the NHLR, firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts, the 2014 FFLA report and the Forest Service list. The 1940 abandonment year is a placeholder for 'the 1940s'. No source found sets current access, rental or permit rules, so no access key is set. Idaho Fire Lookouts asks readers not to publish the location, so the story gives no directions and the trail note is only hike-in. The FFLA report's title comes from its filename, not the document itself. The brief's coordinates, elevation and design match the sources.
